name: Maya Scott
life: “I still remember the awkwardness of apologizing in work clothes.” People around Harbour Bakery know Maya by a small Saturday habit. Maya buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I don't like apologies delivered in uniform. I have offered to come back after my watch.
appearance: Maya has a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape, a narrow face with an expressive upper lip, and a favorite piece of clothing, a narrow-striped sweater. It usually goes with a little coil of soft measuring tape. When somebody else has the floor, Maya rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Maya talks very little about private fear and recognizes it quickly in strangers. Offering a choice of seats is one of Maya's ways of saying that it is all right to leave.
agenda: To meet the shopkeeper without a uniform if requested.
family: Olivia Hu is Maya’s second cousin. Maya asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Olivia remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *Five missing lunches*, Olivia says, “I bought the empty tins by weight at the charity sale.”
connections: Bea Morgan. A visit after watch gives a worker time to check the photograph against the dates of leave.

reactions.situation: The shopkeeper asks for a public correction
reactions.response: Maya agrees a place and size for the correction with the person who was named.

reactions.situation: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off
reactions.response: Maya asks the driver to come back on foot and look at the damaged goods before discussing cost.
reactions.asWritten: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off. Maya asks the driver to come back on foot and look at the damaged goods before discussing cost.

reactions.situation: When pressed to explain someone else's silence
reactions.response: Maya says only what happened and lets the absent person keep their reasons.
